_meta.purpose: Reproducible runtime evidence for born-somewhere v5.50. Captured against the LIVE deployed site so the claims can be re-checked independently rather than taken from a prior session's assertion.
_meta.captureMethod: chrome-devtools-mcp evaluate_script; service workers unregistered + all caches cleared + reload before capture, so results reflect deployed code and not a stale SW cache
_meta.supersedes: evidence/v5.49-runtime-verification.json (same measurements plus the new intro soft-toggle)

whatChangedInThisVersion.v5.50: Added the intro-page 略過可怕的情節 toggle (#softBtnIntro) and the heavy-content warning line (.warnline), matching the original's #softBtn2 which also lives on the intro page. Both buttons now share one toggleSoftMode() handler. Added intro.heavy / intro.softBtn / intro.ageGate i18n keys for all 9 languages.
whatChangedInThisVersion.v5.49: Last two hardcoded white backgrounds (.tree-controls input[type=text], .tree-controls select) removed.
whatChangedInThisVersion.v5.48: Site-wide leak sweep: .ty-event white background, form controls (input/select/option/placeholder/checkbox/radio), and two inline SVG world-map backgrounds set to var(--bg-3).
whatChangedInThisVersion.v5.47: life-grid columns aligned to the measured original values 320px / minmax(0,1fr) / 340px; family panel moved from column A to column C per the original.

introSoftToggleVerification.conclusion: Clicking the intro button flips #softBtnIntro, the life-topbar #btnSoftMode, STATE.softMode and localStorage together — the two entry points are in sync.

en.topbarTitle: Heavy events are hidden — click to show them

i18n.afterLanguageSwitch: aria-pressed stayed 'true' — state survives language switching

lightLeakSweep_inheritedFromV549.method: For each view (intro/life/end/lab/tree/shelf): setView(v), walk every body descendant, skip .memorial-wall (intentionally dark-only) and any element with width<8 or height<8 or not visible; flag computed backgroundColor with r>100 && g>95 && b>80 and alpha>=0.05. Accent/data colours excluded by explicit allow-list.

excludedAsIntentional.rgb(225, 233, 230): inverted active chip — original 1in8b.life .seg button[aria-pressed=true] uses background: var(--ink)

staticAnalysisResolution.concern: A per-function heuristic flagged ~60 candidate undeclared identifiers in template literals; previously left unresolved.
staticAnalysisResolution.method: File-wide declaration audit over app.js: collected every name bound by const/let/var/function/class, all destructuring bindings, all function parameters (named + arrow, including single-param arrows without parens), and loop/callback variables; subtracted a browser-global allow-list and app-level globals (STATE, COUNTRIES, I18N, LANG, STORAGE_KEY, ...).
staticAnalysisResolution.conclusion: Every identifier used inside ${...} is either declared in app.js or a legitimate browser/app global. No remaining undeclared-variable crash risk of this shape.
staticAnalysisResolution.caveat: A file-wide audit cannot prove scope-correctness — a name declared in one function and used in another would pass it. Dynamic coverage remains the stronger signal: the one real crash of this class (auto in showFinanceModal, v5.42) was found by playing the game, not by static analysis.

layoutAlignment_vsOriginal.evidenceFile: evidence/1in8b.life-reference.json + evidence/1in8b.life-styles.css (captured from the live original via getComputedStyle)
layoutAlignment_vsOriginal.familyPanelColumn: C (moved in v5.47 to match the original, where .p-fam sits in the third column)

howToReproduce: 3. confirm footer reads v5.50 and the intro shows 略過可怕的情節 under the 出 生 button
4. click that button — it should turn into a filled pill, and STATE.softMode === true
5. for the full-life run: click 出生, 開始這段人生, set 16x, then auto-click through pause/focus/finance modals for ~30s
6. for the leak sweep: setView over intro/life/end/lab/tree/shelf and walk each view's visible elements checking computed backgroundColor
knownRemainingLimitations: Scope-correctness is not proven exhaustively; the static audit is file-wide, and runtime coverage only exercises the paths actually played.
Leak scan excludes .memorial-wall because that section is intentionally dark-only by design in both projects; if it is ever themed light, it would need re-checking.

The 1in8b.life comparison is based on computed styles and inline CSS captured on 2026-10-20 from v0.7.89; the original may have changed since, so the reference artifacts are a point-in-time snapshot rather than a live contract.
